description:
The OpenVPN administration service, identified as **openvpn‑admin**, is slated for deployment with a modest resource footprint. Each OpenVPN instance will be allocated **0.5 CPU shares** and **256 MB of memory**, and we plan to run **two instances** of the service to ensure redundancy and handle the anticipated load.

Please update the orchestration configuration accordingly, using the service name **openvpn‑admin** for all related tasks and monitoring alerts. Let me know if any adjustments are required.
